description: Output pieces of FILE to PREFIXaa, PREFIXab, ...; default size is 1000 lines, and default PREFIX is 'x'.

option.name: --additional-suffix
tip: append an additional SUFFIX to file names

option.name: --bytes
tip: put SIZE bytes per output file

option.name: --elide-empty-files
tip: do not generate empty output files with '-n'

option.name: --filter
tip: write to shell COMMAND; file name is $FILE

option.name: --hex-suffixes
tip: same as -x, but allow setting the start value

option.name: --line-bytes
tip: put at most SIZE bytes of records per output file

option.name: --lines
tip: put NUMBER lines/records per output file

option.name: --number
tip: generate CHUNKS output files; see explanation below

option.name: --numeric-suffixes
tip: same as -d, but allow setting the start value

option.name: --separator
tip: use SEP instead of newline as the record separator; '\0' (zero) specifies the NUL character

option.name: --unbuffered
tip: immediately copy input to output with '-n r/...'

option.name: --verbose
tip: print a diagnostic just before each output file is opened

option.name: -d
tip: use numeric suffixes starting at 0, not alphabetic

option.name: -x
tip: use hex suffixes starting at 0, not alphabetic
